title: Muse Spark 1.1 adapter and benchmark evaluation
description: Build a bounded Meta Model API adapter and a reproducible cross-model benchmark packet to evaluate Muse Spark 1.1 against strict correctness, safety, cost, and reliability gates, supporting exactly one terminal disposition: REJECTED, BOUNDED_USE, or PROMOTED_WITH_SCOPE.
pain_point: No systematic, reproducible evidence packet exists to support routing promotion decisions; vendor claims and third-party evaluations are not independently verified; without a bounded adapter and benchmark, there is risk of silent paid-model fallback, authority-boundary failures, or cost inefficiency from an unvetted model.
use_case: Evaluating whether Muse Spark 1.1 belongs in the HUMMBL / Ownward model-routing stack by constructing a provider-isolated adapter and running fixed benchmark tasks (MCP reliability, governed delegation, repository execution, long-context integrity, computer-use safety, cost-adjusted correctness) with identical inputs and success criteria across Muse and comparison models (GPT-5.6 Luna, Terra, Sol, Claude Fable 5, current promoted free/local lane).

title: HVAC Review Inbox Exact Latest Notes
description: 需要一个能精确保留最新HVAC审核笔记的收件箱，附带页面标签、路由、URL、viewport、user agent、优先级、种类和可见上下文，以确保ChatGPT/Codex等AI工具能完整读取全文。此外，当收件箱过长导致截断时，需要轮换到新的exact-latest收件箱，并在行动前引用或总结最新的笔记文本和来源页面。
pain_point: 当HVAC审核收件箱过长时，笔记文本被截断，导致ChatGPT/Codex等AI工具无法完整读取最新笔记内容，影响自动化处理。同时，缺乏精确保留最新笔记并附带完整上下文信息的机制。
use_case: 用户在进行HVAC审核时，需要将最新的笔记文本及附带的页面标签、路由、URL、viewport、user agent、优先级、种类和可见上下文准确保留在收件箱中，以便ChatGPT/Codex等AI工具能读取全文。当收件箱过长开始截断时，用户需要轮换到新的exact-latest收件箱，并在行动前引用或总结最新的笔记文本和来源页面。

title: First-party PDF viewer for sandbox artifacts
description: In a pure one-off data task (CSV in, PDF report out) run entirely through `gipity sandbox run`, the agent had no first-party way to view the generated PDF. To visually confirm the layout, it had to manually rasterize the PDF to PNG using `pdftoppm` in a second sandbox invocation and then use `Read` on each PNG. This rasterize-and-Read cycle had to be repeated after fixing the chart. The lack of a platform command for viewing generated documents (PDF, docx, etc.) creates friction and adds unnecessary tool calls and wall-clock time.
pain_point: No first-party way to look at a generated PDF. The agent's whole deliverable was a PDF, and it wanted to visually confirm the layout before calling the task done. There is no platform command for that, so it hand-rolled one: a second sandbox invocation running `pdftoppm -png -r 90 docs/sales-report.pdf docs/preview` to rasterize the pages, followed by `Read` on each PNG. It then had to repeat this rasterize-and-Read cycle a second time after fixing the chart. Every sandbox-generated document artifact (PDF, docx, etc.) will hit this same wall.
use_case: User executed a one-off data task (CSV input, PDF report output) via `gipity sandbox run`. The agent needed to visually confirm the layout of the generated PDF before calling the task done. Since there was no first-party way to view the PDF, the agent manually invoked a second sandbox command: `pdftoppm -png -r 90 docs/sales-report.pdf docs/preview` to rasterize pages, then used `Read` on each PNG. After fixing the chart, the agent had to repeat the entire rasterize-and-Read cycle.

title: 提供确定性步进游戏循环的能力
description: Gipity平台在验证canvas/物理/动画游戏时，由于无法确定性步进应用自身的游戏循环，导致实时验证因慢渲染（14.5 fps）而失败，代理无法确认砖块碰撞、得分变化等核心机制，最终放弃验证，仅使用静态截图。平台需要提供一个工具或机制，允许代理在无头环境中步进应用的循环，从而进行快速、可靠的自动化验证。
pain_point: 代理必须依赖实时墙钟时间来等待游戏循环推进，但慢渲染导致物理/动画时间推进极慢，无法在合理时间内观察到砖块碰撞或得分变化；平台虽发出诊断警告，但未提供任何确定性步进游戏循环的工具，代理因而无法验证游戏的核心机制，只能跳过验证步骤。
use_case: 代理使用`gipity page eval`构建了一个Phaser砖块破坏者游戏，并试图通过驱动部署的页面来验证真实的游戏循环（球弹跳、砖块破碎、分数增加、生命减少）。前两个eval成功获取了初始状态和球位置轨迹，但第三次遇到14.5帧/秒的慢渲染警告，提示等待真实时间会使得物理进展过慢，导致断言可能假阴性，建议“step the app's own loop deterministically”。代理没有后续工具可用，放弃验证，转而截图并直接交付游戏，导致砖块碰撞、得分、生命和胜负屏幕从未被验证。
